title: Цитування та експорт
roles: R04, R05, R05-M у власному доступі
fields_and_relations: Exact targets/versions, склад, формат, allowed attribution і результат.
required_interaction: Copy/download/failed/retry; бібліографія окремо від пакета джерел; повторна перевірка прав.

implementation.view_model: Exact source/material citations; TXT/CSL bibliography; selected corpus and owned results as a private research handover JSON with real file bytes, manifest and guarded downloads.
limitations: Browser-local JSON package up to 8 MiB subject to storage quota; no ZIP or remote transfer.
Local stable URN without public resolver; BibTeX/RIS and additional styles remain pending.
Public citation/export still uses current safe publication.
implementation.state_storage: Normalized browser store v9; existing user state is preserved, new grants require explicit human review.
permissions: research.write in an explicit archive grant
domain.read rechecked for every source, note, assertion, citation and download
implementation.atomicity: Authorize, compare expected corpus/assertion revision, mutate clone, validate exact FK/versions and immutable corpus membership hashes, commit once.
implementation.public_view: Private public-source citations, TXT/CSL JSON export, current publication and policy checked before copy/download; guest copy on material page
implementation.subject_access: Requires scoped domain.read and exact-version O47 research; all known relevant consent bases, state, time, embargo, field projection and separate cite/download use are evaluated. Existing exports recheck access and approved title.
